description: Land Acquisition - Raluwa, Weeraketiya D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing multiple land lots being acquired by the government for road construction purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of the lands, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
